EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Dan Kelly, Director of the Shelter Association of Washtenaw County, spoke about the work of the Delonis Shelter. He thanked the Council and City Administrator for their support of the shelter and for affordable housing support. He also spoke in support of the Rising Hope for Housing program.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Dan Kelly - City Administrator's Presentation of Proposed FY26-7 Budget (INT-1) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kathy Griswold, resident, spoke in support of AC-2, Regarding the AAPD's Enforcement Plan for Bicycle Lanes. She also spoke about the 90 blind spots on Miller Road.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kathy Griswold - Response to Resolution Directing Enhanced Enforcement of Bicycle Lane Ordinances (AC-2); and 90 Blind Spots in Miller Bike Lane (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Chuck Ream, resident, spoke in opposition to the proposed Comprehensive Plan, stating the proposed 4 to 7 story buildings that will be allowed in residential zones is absurd. He also expressed concern about the proposed destruction of trees under the proposed Plan.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Chuck Ream - Comprehensive Plan (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Barbara Ladewski, resident, spoke about the proposed Comprehensive Plan and its support of sustainability and diversity.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Barbara Ladewski - Draft of the Comprehensive Plan (Zoom/phone)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Stephan A. Trendov, Ann Arbor Township resident, spoke about the Center of the City ballot initiative.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Stephan A. Trendov - Center of the City / The Commons (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alan Haber, resident, spoke about the Center of the City and the upcoming Charter amendment to reverse it. He stated he sent Council a letter entitled "Integrity" and questioned their decision to vote to place the issue back on the ballot in August.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alan Haber - Integrity (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Mary Henderson, resident, spoke in opposition to the proposed Comprehensive Plan. She urged residents to sign on to the online petition in opposition.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Mary Henderson - Comprehensive Plan (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jeremy Haley, Ypsilanti Township resident, spoke about the proposed Comprehensive Plan, the City's geothermal plans, and the Arbor South proposal.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jeremy Haley - Arbor South Project and Comprehensive Plan (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
COUNCILMEMBER DISCH

Councilmember Disch spoke about the proposed Comprehensive Plan. She stated the plan is designed to encourage more residents in Ann Arbor.


COUNCILMEMBER BRIGGS

Councilmember Briggs addressed the public comments regarding the proposed Comprehensive Plan. She encouraged residents to attend the public sessions coming up to provide input.


COUNCILMEMBER AKMON

Councilmember Akmon also spoke about the proposed Comprehensive Plan. She addressed comments suggesting that the proposed changes won't help with affordable housing.

Councilmember Akmon also highlighted the report from the AAPD regarding the Bicycle Lane enforcement.


COUNCILMEMBER EYER

Councilmember Eyer addressed the loss of a construction worker on a project in the Fourth Ward. 


COUNCILMEMBER MALLEK

Councilmember Mallek announced the upcoming Ward 2 coffee hour with Councilmember Watson.


COUNCILMEMBER HARRISON

Councilmember Harrison thanked Housing Director Jennifer Hall for attending the Ward 1 listening session.


COUNCILMEMBER CORNELL

Councilmember Cornell addressed comments regarding the Center of the City history.
